mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_requests (wallet_id, senior_id, qr_token, status, expires_at) VALUES (#{walletId}, #{seniorId}, #{qrToken}, #{status}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT pr.payment_id, pr.wallet_id, pr.senior_id, pr.qr_token, pr.status, pr.transaction_id, pr.merchant_id, pr.amount, pr.failure_code, pr.expires_at, pr.created_at, pr.updated_at, m.name AS merchant_name, t.completed_at AS paid_at, t.balance_after AS remaining_balance FROM payment_requests pr LEFT JOIN merchants m ON m.merchant_id = pr.merchant_id LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t.transaction_id = pr.transaction_id WHERE pr.payment_id = #{paymentId}

SELECT pr.payment_id, pr.wallet_id, pr.senior_id, pr.qr_token, pr.status, pr.transaction_id, pr.merchant_id, pr.amount, pr.failure_code, pr.expires_at, pr.created_at, pr.updated_at FROM payment_requests pr WHERE pr.qr_token = #{qrToken}
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_requests SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at <= NOW()
UPDATE payment_requests SET status = 'CANCELED' WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at > NOW()
